claim_boundary: Fresh held-out validation of the Sokoban positive-effect guard on the exact Space Sick and Proteomics Easy interfaces for seeds5-10. It does not establish Normal-difficulty or arbitrary DiscoveryWorld transfer.

operational_disclosure.target_only_seed5_resume: The first target-only seed5 process was interrupted after 30 steps and resumed with the same completion cache and deterministic prefix. An independent partial restart was discarded.
operational_disclosure.matched_frame_race: The first parallel matched launch shared non-authoritative frame directories and one task hit a PNG deletion race. All tasks were stopped and resumed from their config-specific completion caches in task-isolated frame directories; only isolated complete results were used.

limitations: Only 8 of 12 frozen tasks were eligible for a matched commit fork.
The 2-win, 0-loss comparison has exact two-sided p=0.5.
Authentic exceeded the commit-availability control by only one success.
V22 Normal difficulty remains a failed zero-coverage result and is not rescued by V23 Easy.
